name: dynamic_gate
description: Layered safe-rejection upstream gate: Layer0 deterministic impossibility (apply_deterministic_gate) + Layer1 AND-of-core-vetoes (el,prime) + Layer2 expression rescue + Layer3 patient-adaptive rails.
